purpose: Expose the existing source-version, reservation, reference-resolution, phase-scoped block-remap, and omitted-record consumer contracts as one fast focused CTest.
changes: Added --consumer-write-facade to run five generated consumer API controls without the full DXF fixture suite.
Moved the five API controls out of the default all-fixtures run; the dedicated selector remains their focused CTest entry point.

Corrected the reservation test to avoid reading an emitted handle back from the caller's DRW_Line; the DXF writer intentionally does not mutate caller entity handles. The control now checks the directly observable generated allocator handle and explicit reservations.
Overrode dx_iface::finalizeDxfWrite in the bounded block-remap writer control because that integration finalizer requires a complete adapter graph outside this API-slice test's scope.

subcontrols: The aggregate selector also runs testConsumerSourceVersionSnapshot, testDxfReferenceResolver, and testDxfWriteLeftOutReporting.

scopeLimit: This verifies generated upstream API and transaction behavior only. It does not qualify native LibreCAD or LibreCAD_3 builds, application import/export, ABI stability, or DWG/DXF support claims.
fixturePolicy: All controls author temporary DXF files locally at runtime; no DWG/DXF fixture was added.
claimEffect: No format support claim changes. The new selector makes the existing API bridge easier to validate during consumer integration.
